# GSD Dark Mode

Activate bounded `P-017` dark-factory execution through the Orchestrator and
`.github/skills/gsd-dark-mode/SKILL.md`.

## Intent

Run autonomous Stage -> Ship execution across a bounded shipment sequence or set
while the operator is AFK, preserving all pipeline policies (`P-001`, `P-009`,
`P-010`, `P-011`, `P-014`, `P-016`, `P-017`, `P-018`, `P-020`, `P-021`),
mandatory pre-PR multi-persona + `rubber-duck` review, and patient multi-round
Copilot review resolution.

## Inputs

* `shipments`: Bounded shipment sequence (such as `[215-S -> 218-S]` or
  `215-S -> 178-S`) or set (such as `[215-S, 178-S, 125-S]`), or explicit
  backlog scope for Stage intake.
* `carry_forward`: Optional uncommitted paths (for example
  `.backlogit/stash.jsonl`, `.gsd/config.yaml`, legacy `.autoharness/config.yaml`,
  or operator-designated `references/*` gitlinks) to carry into the next feature
  branch.

## Requirements

1. Route through the Orchestrator and execute `.github/skills/gsd-dark-mode/SKILL.md`,
   honoring ordered shipment sequences (`[215-S -> 218-S]`) and sets
   (`[215-S, 178-S, 125-S]`) and running the read-only `pre_claim` scope-head
   activation preflight before recording `DARK_MODE_ACTIVE`.
2. Continue autonomously while the operator is AFK using sound, well-reasoned
   engineering judgment until all scoped shipments complete or an unsafe stop
   condition triggers `DARK_MODE_HALTED` (preserving `P-021` non-bypass and the
   per-closure destructive `gsd shipment cascade-close` approval rule).
3. Enforce mandatory pre-PR multi-persona adversarial review including
   `rubber-duck` on all decisions/plans and code, plus full local build/test/lint/gate
   verification before opening any PR.
4. Exercise pre-authorized PR/MR creation and merge-commit approval (`P-009`,
   never squash or rebase): when hosted on GitHub (`GitHub Actions`), wait
   patiently across multiple Copilot review rounds (`gsd gate copilot-review`
   with configured `--enforcement` / `--max-wait` and explicit `--operator-reason`
   when `disabled`, requiring `status: "PASS"` / `SATISFIED`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`,
   or audited `DISABLED` without claiming review completion), commit and **push**
   fixes before replying, resolve addressed bot-authored inline threads via
   `gh api graphql` (`resolveReviewThread`; never auto-resolve human-authored
   threads), and post `Copilot-Review-Body-Disposition: <review databaseId>`
   markers per `.github/instructions/github-pr-automation.instructions.md` §1.6.1 for
   review-body findings; on non-GitHub hosts, use the configured provider's
   `pr-lifecycle` workflow while preserving local readiness (`P-014`) and
   approval checks.
5. Handle `P-011` carry-forward commits for `.backlogit/stash.jsonl`,
   `.gsd/config.yaml` (legacy `.autoharness/config.yaml`), and operator-designated
   gitlinks onto the feature branch without listing `ForeignPaths` in task file
   budgets.
